stories.title: Masdar completes $950 million solar and battery storage project in California
stories.description: The Abu Dhabi clean energy developer and its joint venture partner Terra-Gen have brought the Lockhart complex online, adding 365 MW of solar generation and 173.7 MW of energy storage to the California grid.

stories.title: Transparent bamboo boosts energy performance of solar PV skylights
stories.description: Researchers tested 21 glazing configurations using transparent wood and PV modules with different transparency levels. Bamboo-based systems achieved the lowest heat gain and cooling operating costs.

stories.title: Ask HN: What are the most useful, concrete AI skills to independently learn?
stories.description: Specifically, what are the most useful, concrete skills to learn as an individual to take economic advantage of the advances in LLMs, agents and associated new technological capabilities?What is accessible to learn just from the internet and experimentation, without a degree program, assuming a preexisting moderately technical background?

stories.title: The Download: Silicon Valley’s blind spot and Nvidia’s chip-tracking plan
stories.description: This is today’s edition of The Download, our weekday newsletter that provides a daily dose of what’s going on in the world of technology. Silicon Valley claims to know the future. So why did it get the midterms so wrong?

stories.title: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
stories.description: Nvidia poured tens of billions into AI startups under Huang. Without him at the helm, founders and VCs are bracing for smaller checks and lower valuations.

stories.title: This young startup wants to power floating data centers with the ocean’s heat, and investors are already on board
stories.description: Drogue is harvesting heat from the ocean to power data centers on floating vessels. The first prototype should be bobbing around the ocean, crunching bits, in less than two years.

stories.title: What do Christmas market traders say about rising prices?
stories.description: From £8 bratwursts to £11 Yorkshire pudding wraps, why is the cost of the markets rising year on year?

stories.title: Food bank sees donations drop by 10% each year
stories.description: Staff fear the government stockpiling advice will have an impact on donations as Christmas looms.

stories.title: Formal Conjectures: An Open and Evolving Benchmark for Verified Discovery in Mathematics
stories.description: arXiv:2605.13171v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: As automated reasoning systems advance rapidly, there is a growing need for research-level formal mathematical problems to accurately evaluate their capabilities.

stories.title: Scientists discover a hidden danger of viral infections that vaccines may prevent
stories.description: A new study reveals that viral infections may leave behind hidden damage to the immune system long after symptoms disappear. Researchers found that mice recovering from an acute infection experienced lasting changes to their spleens and weakened immune responses, potentially leaving them more vulnerable to future threats.

stories.title: UNSW develops three-minute lithium-ion battery health test
stories.description: Researchers at the University of New South Wales (UNSW) have developed a prototype that uses electrical pulses and statistical models to assess lithium-ion battery health in under three minutes per cell, with a potential role in sorting retired batteries for reuse or recycling.

stories.title: Effect-Level Validation for Causal Discovery in Interactive Telemetry
stories.description: arXiv:2602.08340v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Causal discovery is increasingly used to analyze telemetry from interactive systems, but a plausible graph does not guarantee an identifiable or reliable product decision. We study this problem for one query: whether early competitive gameplay increases Day-1 retention in a deployed Role-playing game (RPG).
